newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bank deposits rise 1.3 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bank deposits rise 1.3 pct in August.

text.p: Total deposits in Venezuelan commercial banks rose 50 billion bolivars, or 1.3 percent, to 3.92 trillion bolivars ($8.2 billion) in August, from 3.87 trillion bolivars in July, according to the financial consultants Softline Consultores.
Of the total deposits in 38 commercial banks, 38.8 percent were in current accounts and 33.9 percent in savings accounts. The remainder were in sight deposits and time deposits, Softline said.
Credit portfolios grew by 113.465 billion bolivars, or 8.0 percent in August to 1.53 trillion bolivars.

Among leading banks, Banco Provincial clung onto the top spot with 23.8 percent of total deposits followed by Banco Mercantil with 10.9 percent, Banco Venezuela with 10.2 percent, Banco Consolidado with 7.1 percent and Banco Union with 7.0 percent.
